_about: The I-765 (work permit) cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The subject (the category), the address (uscis.gov/i-765-addresses, updated 03/03/2026) and the fee (Form G-1055 10/01/26, Appendix C) come from src/work_permit.py. The attorney approves this file before volume use.
re_lines: Application: I-765 Application for Employment Authorization

forms.g28_ead: Applicant’s G-28 - Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative
forms.ead: Applicant’s I-765 - Application for Employment Authorization

documents: Copies of USCIS Notices (the basis of the category)
Copy of the Form I-485 Receipt Notice
Copy of Applicant’s Current Employment Authorization Document (front and back)

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
Enclose the fee or fees the cover letter states by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: a Pub. L. 119-21 fee as its own payment.
